about: fs-throw-49 per-site classification of the 49 baseline throwing std::filesystem calls (harvest/fs_throw_baseline-1e49188b.txt). Mac-only: every claim is from local source reading on 2026-10-12; no console contact, no console logs. Line numbers are for the CURRENT tree (B4 state); check_classification.py proves every site below matches the gate's own scan of that tree and the baseline keys.
R0: On PS5 the native mod source is ALWAYS set: the only start path BR:1995 -> ACK:87 PrepareActivatedUE4SSRuntime -> BK:88-90 sets context.mod_source = MakeActivatedUE4SSModSource(), which returns make_shared (AMS:45) or throws (AMS:23,26,39,41). Two compiled factories build a UE4SSProgram WITHOUT a mod source: PrepareDeferredUE4SSRuntime (BK:79-82) and CreateNativeUE4SSProgram (NPF:5-22, make_unique<UE4SSProgram> at NPF:14; its context comes from MakeNativeProgramContext, NLC:7-22, which never sets mod_source). Neither has a caller in the 3,561 compiled files, the 335 unscanned prebuilt-object sources or the package lineage (grep 2026-10-12: CreateNativeUE4SSProgram appears only in its own .hpp/.cpp; the only other UE4SSProgram construction in scope is BK:47, inside UE4SSBackend, reached with a mod source only via BK:102). Nothing resets it. UPH:279-282: native_mod_source() returns m_native_context.mod_source.

verdicts.UNREACHABLE-ON-PS5: never executed by the shipped PS5 start path (R0 guard, no caller, or dead code); also listed: what would catch it if a future build made it reachable
verdicts.HANDLED: reachable on PS5 and already inside a catch on every path found; outcome given in if_throws
verdicts.UNHANDLED: reachable and no catch: needs a patch (none found)
